title: What if you were dropped into a zombie outbreak in England

shots.text: You've got ten minutes before London is overrun.
First, forget guns. In England, your best weapon is a cricket bat.
Don't go near the Tube. It's a tunnel full of dead ends.
Grab a bike. The roads will be jammed, and bikes are quiet.
Now head for a castle. England has hundreds, and they were built to keep people out.
Thick stone walls, one way in, and most had their own well for water.
So... which castle are you running to?
